descriptor: UI kit for tooltips and popovers

voice.summary: Writes like documentation by someone who loves edge cases: exact, short and a bit proud of a nicely flipped tooltip. Plain explanations beat clever ones.
dos: Explain behaviour with one concrete example
Name placements exactly: top, right, bottom, left
Keep tooltip text to one short line
donts: No jargon like collision resolution in labels

boilerplate: Anchor is a UI component kit for tooltips and popovers that flip and shift to stay inside the viewport, with accessible triggers and rich content.

microcopy.error: Couldn't position that popover. Try another side.
microcopy.empty: No content to show here yet.

logo.note: A bold A reads like a pointer arrow and gives a firm anchor point.
